svg.text: Glass-box demo: who talks to whom

From the browser through the UI server on the Mac mini to the Private AI Services 3.0 agent, and from the agent to the model endpoint, the knowledge base and the MCP servers. Numbers mark the paths, explained below.
PRIVATE AI SERVICES 3.0 · vSphere Supervisor sv01, namespace pais
PAIS token stays on the Mini
certificate from a trusted lab CA
search tool in the agent: top 3 chunks
spans: model calls, tool calls, retrievals,
GraphQL, read by the UI server (8)
Browser -> UI server: question over HTTP, answer streamed back (SSE). The browser never holds the token.
UI server -> agent endpoint: HTTPS with the bearer token from the Mini, answer streamed back the same way.
Runtime <-> model endpoint: chat completion plus tool definitions over the gateway route (A5000, Claude or RTX 4090).
Runtime -> knowledge base: question embedded with bge-m3, pgvector search, top 3 chunks go back into the prompt.
Runtime -> MCP server lab-test: tool call over Streamable HTTP with that server's token, result back to the model.
Runtime -> MCP server on the Mini -> vCenter: read tools only, ReadOnly account; nothing writes into the lab.
Runtime -> Phoenix: every model call, tool call and retrieval becomes a span with duration and tokens in / out.
UI server -> Phoenix GraphQL: polls the trace after the answer and fills the right panel of the page.

PAIS = Private AI Services · MCP = Model Context Protocol · SSE = server-sent events · vGPU = virtual GPU · VCF = VMware Cloud Foundation · bearer token = one secret per server, stored on the Mini only
